    return Invoice("inv_1","cus_1",lines=[LineItem("x",1,Decimal(total))],status=status)

# idempotency
audit.clear()
i=inv()
r1=issue_credit_note(i,Decimal("10.00"),"goodwill",idempotency_key="k1")
r2=issue_credit_note(i,Decimal("10.00"),"goodwill",idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1==r2
assert len(audit.events("credit_note_issued"))==1
assert audit.events("credit_note_issued")[0]["idempotency_key"]=="k1"
# idempotency checked before state
i.status="paid"
r3=issue_credit_note(i,Decimal("10.00"),"goodwill",idempotency_key="k1")
assert r3==r1
# approval
audit.clear()
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv(),Decimal("500.01"),"x")
    raise SystemExit("should fail")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="approval_required", e.code
assert issue_credit_note(inv(),Decimal("500.00"),"x")["amount"]==Decimal("500.00")
assert issue_credit_note(inv(),Decimal("500.01"),"x",approved_by="mgr")["amount"]==Decimal("500.01")
# invalid state
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv(status="draft"),Decimal("1.00"),"x")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="invalid_state"
print("all edge cases ok")
